### EQC001 — GKSL generator in the paper's vectorization convention

*Fixes the basis ordering, transpose convention, and matrix exponential used independently for both numerical figures.*

$$
\operatorname{vec}(|i\rangle\langle j|)=|i\rangle|j\rangle,\qquad \mathbf L=-i(H\otimes I-I\otimes H^T)+\sum_k\left[L_k\otimes\overline{L_k}-\frac12 L_k^\dagger L_k\otimes I-\frac12I\otimes(L_k^\dagger L_k)^T\right],\qquad \operatorname{vec}[\rho(t)]=e^{t\mathbf L}\operatorname{vec}[\rho(0)]
$$

status: `verified` · source: tex_section: appendix:lindblad_to_choi; tex_contains: \bm{L} = -i(H \ox I - I \ox H^T)

Numerical form:

```
Build the d^2-by-d^2 complex matrix with NumPy Kronecker products and evaluate scipy.linalg.expm(t*L).
```

### EQC002 — Liouville-to-Choi reshuffling

*Converts each generated Lindblad channel into the unnormalized Choi matrix used as both target channel and program resource.*

$$
J(\mathcal E_t)=\sum_{i,j=0}^{d-1}|i\rangle\langle j|\otimes\mathcal E_t(|i\rangle\langle j|)=\sum_{i,j,a,b=0}^{d-1}K_{ab,ij}(t)|i\rangle\langle j|\otimes|a\rangle\langle b|,\qquad K(t)=e^{t\mathbf L}
$$

*Separates Fig. 2 into an exactly programmable coherent branch and a physical Bell-dephasing branch.*

$$

$$

### EQC010 — Diamond norm SDP for Hermiticity-preserving maps

*Replaces the authors' QETLAB call by a transparent small SDP and fixes the factor of two in the epsilon constraint.*

$$
\|\Phi\|_\diamond=\min_{Z,\mu}\left\{\mu:\ Z\succeq0,\ Z+J(\Phi)\succeq0,\ Z-J(\Phi)\succeq0,\ \operatorname{tr}_{\mathrm{out}}Z\preceq\mu I_{\mathrm{in}}\right\}\quad(\Phi\ \mathrm{Hermiticity\ preserving})
$$

